## Deep Tendon Reflexes (DTRs)

-   **0** = None
-   **1** = any reflex WITH distraction/reinforcement maneuver
-   **2** = Normal reflex in one joint/muscle
-   **3** = Spread of reflex **(not amplitude of response)**
-   **4** = Clonus (\>2--3 beats)

**Common DTRs**:

-   Biceps (C5-C6)
-   Brachioradialis (C5-C6)
-   Triceps (C6-C7)
-   Knee / Patellar (L4-L5)
-   Ankle / Achilles (S1-S2)

**Jaw jerk** --- helps distinguish upper motor neuron (increased) from lower motor neuron or spinal cord lesions.

## Pathological Reflexes

-   **Hoffman sign**
-   **Babinski sign**
-   **Frontal release signs** (primitive reflexes):
    -   Glabellar tap
    -   Rooting
    -   Snouting
    -   Palmomental
    -   Grasp reflex

::: callout-tip
Test with reinforcement (Jendrassik maneuver) if reflexes are hypoactive
:::
